d:
A bipedal plant-based species resembling a poncho-wearing dancer. The head is a bright lime-green color with a deep forest-green crest and a large, bright yellow flower blooming on top. The eyes are small, black, and circular, and the body is a bright lime-green with a cream-colored belly and red-patterned poncho-like skin. It has three-fingered hands and a short, stubby lime-green tail.
BODY COLOR: bright lime-green
